title: Testing the Difference Between Means (Small Independent Samples)

hints: This test is used when sample sizes are small.

options: The sample sizes must be equal.
Both populations must be normally distributed.
The population standard deviations must be known.
questions.prompt: Which of the following is a required condition for a two‑sample t‑test for the difference between means?
questions.feedbackIfWrong: Both populations must be normally distributed (or approximately normal).
